blurb: Benelux Brasserie Artisanale produces and serves a variety of craft beers including IPAs, stouts, lagers, and specialty brews. They offer beer for takeout in various formats including bottles, cans, and pitchers. Their pubs also serve food such as EuroDogs, charcuterie, and snacks, alongside cocktails and other drinks.
